name: dnd-tabletop
description: A D&D battle map and animated dice that Claude (as your Dungeon Master) draws and rolls inline in the chat.
long_description:
Claude runs your D&D game and controls a grid battle map and animated dice through four tools: `map`, `show_map`, `roll` and `notes`. The map and dice render as interactive cards right in the conversation. Campaign notes and house rules are plain markdown files on your computer. No accounts, no API keys, no servers, no connectors.

Works in Claude Desktop (local extensions). Not available in claude.ai in the browser or on mobile.

tools.name: map
tools.description: Edit the battle map: terrain, tokens, scenes, rooms and generators (silent; show_map displays it).

tools.name: show_map
tools.description: Show the current map card in the chat.

tools.name: roll
tools.description: Roll dice with an animated dice card; secret rolls for the DM.

tools.name: notes
tools.description: Read and update campaign.md and house_rules.md sections.

detail.title: Tool result detail
detail.description: lean (default, fewest tokens) or detailed (more descriptive results, e.g. move distances).

data_dir.title: Campaign folder (optional)
data_dir.description: Where campaign.md, house_rules.md and the map state live. Leave empty for the default app data folder.
